title: Giant herring

# Giant herring

Type: Fish | Internal ID: fish6 | Source: Fishing | Usage: Decoration | Cooking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Giant herring are passive creatures (fish) found in the waters just offshore of the Swamp biome.
They can be caught with a fishing pole using a Sticky fishing bait which can be crafted at the Food preparation table by combining 20 Fishing bait and an Abomination Trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

### Crafting

• Result: Raw fish | Ingredients: Giant herring x1 | Crafting Station: Food preparation table

## Notes

• Has a unique line: "What's that nasty smell? Surely it couldn't be me!"
• When caught, has chance to also give Iron ore.

Categorias: Fish, Fishing
